speaker: Doctor
text:
The mention of Pyelonephritis by your previous doctor seems inconsistent with your large ovarian mass and increased abdominal girth, so let's focus on the ovarian findings. Have you experienced any sudden, sharp episodes of abdominal pain, nausea, or dizziness recently?

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Ovarian Fibroma (likely with Meigs syndrome given the shortness of breath and ascites, despite the normal CA-125). The clinical picture of a large, likely benign ovarian mass causing ascites (increased girth) and pleural effusion (shortness of breath) without elevated tumor markers strongly points to this diagnosis over malignancy.
